interpretation.name: Lagna (Ascendant)
interpretation.significance: Self, personality, physical body, and overall life direction. The most important house.

interpretation.name: Dhana Bhava
interpretation.significance: Wealth, family, speech, and accumulated resources. Early childhood and values.

interpretation.name: Sahaja Bhava
interpretation.significance: Courage, siblings, short travels, and communication. Self-effort and skills.

interpretation.name: Sukha Bhava
interpretation.significance: Mother, home, emotional peace, and property. Education and domestic happiness.

interpretation.name: Putra Bhava
interpretation.significance: Children, creativity, intelligence, and romance. Past life merit (Purva Punya).

interpretation.name: Ari Bhava
interpretation.significance: Enemies, diseases, debts, and service. Daily work routine and obstacles.

interpretation.name: Kalatra Bhava
interpretation.significance: Marriage, partnerships, and business. Public dealings and open enemies.

interpretation.name: Randhra Bhava
interpretation.significance: Longevity, transformation, occult, and inheritance. Research and hidden matters.

interpretation.name: Dharma Bhava
interpretation.significance: Fortune, higher learning, spirituality, and father. Long journeys and luck.

interpretation.name: Karma Bhava
interpretation.significance: Career, profession, reputation, and authority. Public life and achievements.

interpretation.name: Labha Bhava
interpretation.significance: Gains, income, elder siblings, and fulfillment of desires. Friends and networks.

interpretation.name: Vyaya Bhava
interpretation.significance: Losses, expenses, foreign lands, and liberation. Bed pleasures and spirituality.
